text:
maria: Nightly eval flagged a regression on q4 builds for redwood-3b. dialogue-coherence dropped ~6% vs baseline, and a bunch of samples show abrupt truncation/repetition near the end of generations. CI diff: https://ci.internal/reports/173820
zheng: Can you paste an example gen?
maria: Sure — from prompt id 4812: 
```
Input: "Tell me a bedtime story about an old lighthouse keeper and a storm."
Baseline: "...the keeper climbed the stairs, lighting the lamp. The storm passed and the village slept."
Q4 nightly: "...the keeper climbed the stairs, lighting the lamp. The storm passed and the storm passed and the storm passed and the storm"
```
zheng: Huh, repeating tail. Looks like sampling got stuck in a small loop. Any infra errors?
eva-bot: nightly-run-173820: 1 worker reboot, 2 slow-sampler warnings, avg latency +30ms on step 8. Artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-evals/nightly/173820/
devon: I saw slow-sampler warnings too. Scheduler log shows a 120ms scheduler hold on gpu-2 around that job. Could be time-slicing preemption.
maria: Interesting — this only affects quantized q4 kernels, not fp16. Could preemption expose a race in the token sampler state machine?
zheng: Possible. Quantized samplers keep a small ring buffer for logits/kv windows; preemption during top-k/top-p selection could leave a stale probability vector.
devon: I can repro-ish locally by inserting a sleep in the sampler between softmax and argmax in the q4 path. Quick patch added: sleep 0.05s triggers repetition 80% of runs.
maria: Nice repro. What's immediate mitigation for nightly?
devon: We can pin sampler to single-thread for q4 in the nightly job (cheap) and add a fast guard in the sampler to copy logits atomically before argmax. I'll open a PR.
zheng: Also add a fuzz test that injects scheduler preemption (signal/sleep) into the sampling loop and assert no token repeats >3 times.
ops-bot: created incident INC-2024-173820: temporary mitigation applied (single-thread q4 sampler) — rollback planned after fix.
maria: Thanks. Can someone own the postmortem + triage? I'll book a quick sync.
devon: I'll own the patch+CI change. PR link will land in the thread.
zheng: I'll land fuzz tests and a small eval to run the tricky promptset under heavy preemption simulator.
maria: Great. Leaving notes: add metric to detect tail-repeat spikes (n-gram repeat rate) so nightly alerts earlier. :thumbsup:
